title: 安全员评估测试问答
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/02_Safety Evaluation Test Questions & Answers (Officers) Safety Officer Test HSE ST.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/02_Safety Evaluation Test Questions & Answers (Officers) Safety Officer Test HSE ST/src.py

points.K5: 有限空间作业的安全要求

shots.scene: 欣欣站在抢答台后，台上空白卡片朝下扣着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a stack of blank cards face down and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的安全抢答，不给选项！
overlay: 安全知识抢答：二十道简答题

shots.scene: 图标一排：氧气分子、井口、焊枪、事故表、梯子、护栏
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: an oxygen molecule, a manhole, a welding torch, a blank chart, a ladder and a guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧、有限空间、动火、事故、登高。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着空白卡片发愣，额头冒汗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a blank question card and sweats nervously.
shots.narration: 阿杰慌了：没有选项，我该怎么答？

shots.scene: 小研递给他一个空白笔记本和笔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank notebook and a pen with a calm smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把想到的要点写下来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起空白题卡，没有ABCD选项
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank question card with no option boxes.
shots.narration: 二十道题，每题五分，八成及格。

shots.scene: 面试桌两侧坐着王老师和阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student sit across a desk like an interview.
shots.narration: 就像面试，没人给你选项。

shots.scene: 阿杰在本子上写要点，旁边思考气泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes bullet points in a blank notebook with a thought bubble above his head.
shots.narration: 先在心里组织答案，记在本子上。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案卡打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his notebook with an answer card and ticks items.
shots.narration: 最后再核对，看看答对了几题。

shots.scene: 一个空气圆饼图，一小块是氧气
shots.prompt_en: A simple pie chart of air with one slice highlighted by an oxygen molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：空气里的氧气占多少？

shots.scene: 其余大块标着氮气图标
shots.prompt_en: The larger part of the pie chart shows a nitrogen molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：百分之二十一，或20.8%。

shots.scene: 一个地下水池的入口，风管伸进去
shots.prompt_en: An underground tank entrance with a large flexible air duct inserted into it from a blower. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：有限空间怎么保证通风？

shots.scene: 鼓风机送风、排风扇抽风，箭头循环
shots.prompt_en: Air movers and a blower pushing fresh air in and an exhaust fan pulling air out, with circulating arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 靠空气推动器、鼓风机和排风扇。

shots.scene: 焊接火花四溅的图标，周围空白
shots.prompt_en: A welding spark icon with scattered sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：焊接作业要准备什么？

shots.scene: 灭火器、防火毯、水带图标一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a fire extinguisher, a fire blanket and a coiled fire hose. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、防火毯、消防水带备在旁边。

shots.scene: 一名监火人站在焊工旁观察
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer welds wearing a face shield while the security officer stands nearby watching as fire watch.
shots.narration: 有经过培训的监火人全程看守。

shots.scene: 气体检测仪和洒水湿润地面的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a portable gas detector and a watering can wetting the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 先做气体检测，必要时把地面打湿。

shots.scene: 焊工戴面罩、手套、穿防护服
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a welding helmet, leather gloves and protective jacket.
shots.narration: 焊工穿戴好面罩、手套和防护服。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 井口旁摆着空白许可证和检测仪
shots.prompt_en: A blank work permit and a gas detector placed beside an open manhole with a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：有限空间作业有哪些要求？
overlay: 有限空间作业的安全要求

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 许可证、检测仪图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A permit icon and a gas detector icon with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 先办作业许可，进入前做气体检测。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 井口外老李拿着空白登记表记录进出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands outside a manhole holding a blank entry log sheet as the attendant.
shots.narration: 外面有培训过的监护人，登记进出。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 全身式安全带、救生绳、三脚架、空气呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full body harness, a lifeline, a rescue tripod and a self-contained breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 备好安全带、救生绳和空气呼吸器。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 吊带、绳索和气笛图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of lifting slings, a coiled rope and a small air horn. No people.
shots.narration: 还有吊带、绳索和报警气笛。

shots.scene: 井内剖面图，几个危险图标漂浮
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a confined tank with floating hazard icons inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：有限空间有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 缺氧、骷髅、火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a low oxygen gauge, a skull and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧，有毒气体，可燃气体。

shots.scene: 湿滑台阶和昏暗灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a slippery step and a dim light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 还有湿滑绊倒和照明不良。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格，三栏图标：步骤、危害、措施
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with three column icons: footsteps, a hazard triangle and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：什么是JSA？

shots.scene: 作业被切成几个方块，一步一步
shots.prompt_en: A long task bar cut into several blocks with arrows between them. No people.
shots.narration: 把一项作业拆成一个个步骤。

shots.scene: 每个方块下方出现危害和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Under each block appear a hazard icon and a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 找出每步的危害，定好控制措施。

shots.scene: 老李把空白表格夹在许可证上，向工人讲解
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clips the blank table to a work permit and explains it to two workers.
shots.narration: 附在作业许可上，开工前讲给每个人。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，从创可贴到黑色花圈图标
shots.prompt_en: Five rising steps with icons from a bandage, a medicine box, a restricted sign, a calendar with a cross, to a black ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：事故分哪几类？

shots.scene: 依次亮起前几级
shots.prompt_en: The first steps light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 急救、医疗处理、限制工作、损失工时、死亡。

shots.scene: 所有台阶旁的记录本打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank record book with a check mark beside every step. No people.
shots.narration: 这几类都属于可记录事故。

shots.scene: 一个分数：上面伤害图标，下面时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction: an injury icon above the line and a clock icon below it. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：事故率怎么算？

shots.scene: 分子伤害数乘二十万，分母总工时
shots.prompt_en: A fraction with stacked injury icons times a multiplier block on top and many clock icons on the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 可记录伤害数乘二十万，除以总工时。

shots.scene: 分数：上面日历图标，下面时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction: a calendar icon above the line and a clock icon below. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：严重率怎么算？

shots.scene: 日历被撕掉几页，代表损失的工作日
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with several torn off pages next to a multiplier block and clock icons. No people.
shots.narration: 损失天数乘二十万，除以总工时。

shots.scene: 空白多页文件，封面化学瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank multi-page document with a chemical bottle icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：MSDS是什么？

shots.scene: 文件封面亮起
shots.prompt_en: The blank document cover glows with a shield and bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：物质安全数据表。

shots.scene: 罐体里飘着一团灰色蒸气云
shots.prompt_en: A gray vapor cloud floating inside a tank cross-section. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：有限空间里的蒸气云怎么清？

shots.scene: 三个选项图标：火焰加热、泵、排风扇
shots.prompt_en: Three option icons: a heating flame, a pump and an exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 加热？用泵？还是排风扇？

shots.scene: 排风扇亮起打勾，蒸气被抽出罐外
shots.prompt_en: The exhaust fan icon glows with a green check and the vapor is drawn out of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，用排风扇。

shots.scene: 井口里垂下一根照明灯线，闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A work lamp hanging down into a manhole with a lightning icon on the cable. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：有限空间最高用多少伏？

shots.scene: 低电压电池图标配盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A low voltage battery icon with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 原片答案：24伏。

shots.scene: 一条浓度刻度尺，左端低右端高
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal concentration scale from low to high with a flame icon zone in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：LEL是什么意思？

shots.scene: 刻度尺上火焰区的左边界亮起
shots.prompt_en: The left edge of the flame zone on the scale lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸下限：可燃气体能被点燃的最低浓度。

shots.scene: 井下有人倒地，井口外监护人着急
shots.prompt_en: Outside a manhole, the facility engineer as attendant looks alarmed at a collapsed figure below.
shots.narration: 第十四题：监护人能下去救人吗？

shots.scene: 监护人往下跳的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the attendant climbing down into the manhole, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：不能，他不许进去救援。

shots.scene: 监护人吹气笛、打电话求援
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer blows an air horn and calls for help on a phone, staying outside the manhole.
shots.narration: 他可以呼叫其他人和应急救援队。

shots.scene: 厂区管道冒出气体，风向标转动
shots.prompt_en: A pipe leaking gas in an industrial area with a wind sock turning. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：气体泄漏，现场怎么办？

shots.scene: 停止作业的手掌图标，设备开关图标关闭
shots.prompt_en: A stop hand icon and equipment power switches turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 停止作业，关闭所有设备。

shots.scene: 人群沿侧风箭头走向集合点
shots.prompt_en: Workers check a wind sock and walk along an arrow perpendicular to the wind toward an assembly point icon.
shots.narration: 查看风向，往侧风方向撤。

shots.scene: 人们聚到紧急集合点
shots.prompt_en: Workers gather at an emergency assembly point sign crosswind of the leak.
shots.narration: 到侧风方向的紧急集合点。

shots.scene: 一架木梯，刷漆的刷子图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wooden ladder with a paint brush icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：梯子能刷漆吗？

shots.scene: 梯子配“否”的叉号
shots.prompt_en: The ladder next to a large red X meaning no. No people.
shots.narration: 这是刁钻题，答案：否。

shots.scene: 吊钩和吊带图标，下面一个重物
shots.prompt_en: A crane hook and a lifting sling holding a heavy block. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：什么是安全工作载荷？

shots.scene: 吊带上的空白标牌，砝码图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank tag on a lifting sling next to a weight icon. No people.
shots.narration: 吊具能安全承受的最大载荷。

shots.scene: 地面被挖开一条沟槽
shots.prompt_en: A trench dug into the ground with soil piled beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八题：什么是开挖？

shots.scene: 沟槽、坑、洞几个剖面图标
shots.prompt_en: Cross-section icons of a trench, a pit and a cavity in the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 挖走土方形成的沟、槽、坑、洞。

shots.scene: 三种土壤剖面：坚硬、中等、松散
shots.prompt_en: Three soil cross-sections side by side: hard compact soil, medium soil and loose crumbly soil. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九题：土壤分几类？

shots.scene: 三种土壤剖面依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three soil cross-sections light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：三类，A类、B类、C类。

shots.scene: 脚手架平台边缘的护栏：顶栏、中栏、挡脚板
shots.prompt_en: The edge of a scaffold platform with a guardrail: a top rail, a mid rail, a toe board and vertical posts. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十题：护栏系统由什么组成？

shots.scene: 人和工具被护栏挡住，不掉下去
shots.prompt_en: A person icon and a falling tool icon both stopped by the guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 顶栏、中栏、挡脚板和立柱。

shots.scene: 挡脚板挡住滚落的扳手
shots.prompt_en: A toe board stops a rolling wrench at the platform edge. No people.
shots.narration: 既防人坠落，也防物件掉落。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，白板上几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with several icons.
shots.narration: 抢答结束，片尾对答案。

shots.scene: 白板上氧气、风扇、24伏、侧风图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons on a whiteboard: an oxygen molecule, an exhaust fan, a low voltage battery and a wind sock. No people.
shots.narration: 21%、排风扇、24伏、侧风集合。

shots.scene: 公式卡片和土壤三类图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank formula card with a multiplier block and three soil type icons. No people.
shots.narration: 两个率都乘二十万，土壤分ABC。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案卡打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his notebook with an answer card and ticks items.
shots.narration: 想想真被问到，你能答对几题？

shots.scene: 阿杰合上写满要点的本子，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes a notebook full of bullet points and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：不给选项，我也能答了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 先想后答，下次测验见！
